verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a Segments feature with examples like "Paying Customers" and "Have not logged in recently", and profiles "join Segments" when they meet attribute conditions, which implies membership updates dynamically and can trigger automations. Segments are also populated as part of activating data, and an AI agent can build a segment from a plain-text description. The evidence does not show tag-based conditions, does not show behavioral events used as segment criteria (events are documented only as automation triggers), and does not explicitly describe real-time recalculation. Missing for 10: tag-based segment conditions, event/behavior-based segment criteria, explicit documentation of live/dynamic recalculation, independent hands-on corroboration.
